system.notes:
Once, long ago, before The Gloaming forest turned dark and malignant, there were the Green Knights who protected it. Back then, when horrors and demons invariably strayed into the wood, the Green Knights met them. Now, the shadows have been left to creep deep into the forest’s heart. It is a pity the knights are no more. Armored knights wearing cloaks of green leaves and helms of twisted branches. It is said that when they are wounded, flower petals fall instead of droplets of blood.

AC 15 (plate mail), HP 19, ATK 2 bastard sword +4 (1d10) or 1 horn of Gede, MV near, S +3, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 4

Horn of Gede. Once per day, blow the horn to become impervious to all damage for 1d4 rounds.

Oath. 3/day, ADV on a roll made in service of protecting the wilds and natural creatures.

Art by Yuri Perkowski-Domingos, 2024
